verses.sanskrit:
सूर्यदेवो जगन्नाथः प्रकाशयति भूमिकाम् ।
भविष्ये काले धर्मस्य ग्लानिर्भविष्यति ॥
verses.translation: The Sun God, Lord of the world, illuminates all realms. In the future age, there will be a decline of dharma.

verses.sanskrit:
कलौ कल्मषचित्तानां पापद्रव्योपजीविनाम् ।
नामसंकीर्तनं विष्णोर्मोक्षद्वारं सनातनम् ॥
verses.translation: In the age of Kali, for those whose minds are contaminated by sin and who subsist on sinful means, the chanting of Vishnu's holy names is the eternal doorway to liberation.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रजापतिर्वाक्यमिदं बभाषे सर्वलोकहितकाम्यया ।
सत्ययुगे तपो ज्ञानं त्रेतायां यज्ञकर्मणि ।
द्वापरे पूजनं दानं कलौ नामस्मरणं हरेः ॥
verses.translation: Prajapati spoke these words for the welfare of all: In Satya Yuga, the path is austerity and knowledge. In Treta Yuga, sacrifice and rituals. In Dvapara Yuga, worship and charity. In Kali Yuga, the remembrance of Hari's name.
